capabilities: Wrap the current selection in a Mermaid code block
Configure default flow direction (TD or LR)
Parse %% @meta comments and apply styles to rendered diagrams
extras: README is partly developer documentation (build, lint, release workflow); a note says it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no quick way to insert or template Mermaid diagrams or to control how they are styled and placed when rendered.
summary: Editing helper that wraps selections in Mermaid code blocks, inserts flowchart templates, and applies style metadata to rendered diagrams.
